fields.description: Save format revision tag at start of EEPROM image
fields.evidence: FUN_0801a354 reads one 8-byte EEPROM record via DAT_0d000000 into an EWRAM buffer and FUN_0801a4e0 compares the first word back; offset 0x00 holds the revision tag of that record.
fields.name: save_format_tag

fields.description: Bitflags recording which cups/tracks are unlocked
fields.evidence: FUN_0801a4e0 loads the 8-byte record with FUN_0801a354 (DAT_0d000000) and compares 4 words against EWRAM progress state; offset 0x02 word carries unlock flag bits consumed near DAT_02000000 game-state writes.
fields.name: cup_unlock_flags

fields.description: Sound setting selected in the options screen
fields.evidence: FUN_0801a404 stores the 4-word EWRAM options block to EEPROM via DAT_0d000000 and FUN_0801a538 retries that write; offset 0x04 byte carries the sound option read back by FUN_0801a354 into EWRAM near DAT_02000000.
fields.name: options_sound

fields.description: Display setting selected in the options screen
fields.evidence: FUN_0801a404 stores the 4-word EWRAM options block to EEPROM via DAT_0d000000 and FUN_0801a538 retries that write; offset 0x05 byte carries the display option read back by FUN_0801a354 into EWRAM near DAT_02000000.
fields.name: options_display

fields.evidence: FUN_0801a404 writes EWRAM progress words to EEPROM through DAT_0d000000 and FUN_0801a354 reads them back for FUN_0801a4e0 verification; offset 0x06 word holds the points counter kept in EWRAM near DAT_02000000.
fields.name: grandprix_points

fields.description: Bulk record table: repeated per-track entries managed as 8-byte EEPROM records
fields.evidence: FUN_0801a404 writes 8-byte records to DAT_0d000000 in a loop retried by FUN_0801a538, and FUN_0801a354 reads them back 4 words at a time; this span holds the repeated record payloads.
fields.name: record_table

fields.description: Unwritten EEPROM area reading back as erased 0xFF
fields.evidence: FUN_0801a354 and FUN_0801a404 only transfer records inside the used prefix via DAT_0d000000, so bytes past the last written record keep the erased EEPROM value observed here.
fields.name: erased_spare
